title: Response times, spread out
description: every dot = one ticket · jitter reveals the pile-up · by priority

props.name: data
props.description: Individual observations with nonnegative hours and caller-supplied fractional band positions. Rounded positions select the band label and tone; the fixed band viewport preserves the supplied jitter. Invalid hours or positions are unavailable.

props.name: bands
props.description: Ordered labels at integer band positions, starting at zero. Repeated labels retain separate positions.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
